headlines.text: Nasdaq futures slide as surging oil prices and a fresh AI-stock slump rattle traders ahead of the Fed's meeting.
Oil jumps over 2% on fears the Gulf war is escalating after Saudi Arabia shuts a key pipeline and talks with Iran collapse.
Chip stocks slump again after Anthropic's warning on AI development spooks the semiconductor trade.
Odds of a Fed rate hike at Wednesday's FOMC decision surge past 85% as traders brace for a volatile week.
August inflation holds at 3.4% year-over-year, bolstering bets that the Fed will hike rates this week.
Wall Street braces for a make-or-break week as the FOMC decision, Empire State manufacturing data, and import prices all land.
